when.expression: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- sizeOf( flatten(payload.referencias.detalle_referencias.atributos default []) filter ((atributo) -> atributo.atributo == "TIPO_PAGO" and upper(atributo.valor) != "RECARGA" ) ) == 0]

#[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- ( sizeOf( flatten(payload.referencias.detalle_referencias.atributos default []) filter ((atributo) -> atributo.atributo == "TIPO_PAGO" and upper(atributo.valor default "") != "FACTURA" ) ) == 0 ) and upper(payload.estado_transaccion default "") == "PAGADA"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "code": "201", "message": "Registro creado con exito, Id transacción: " ++ (payload[0].id_transaccion as String default "") }

ee:transform.doc:name: set BOT_PARAMETERS Filter Bank Transform Message

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { route0: payload[0].payload, route1: payload[1].payload, route2: payload[2].payload }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::core::Periods output application/json
var pagoOnline = vars.responsePagosOnline.result[0] default {}
var entidadRecaudadora = ( vars.responseBotParameters.Values filter ((item) -> item.Code == "ENTIDAD_RECAUDADORA") )[0].Value default ""
var cuentaRecaudadora = ( vars.responseBotParameters.Values filter ((item) -> item.Code == "CUENTA_RECAUDADORA") )[0].Value default ""
var fechaRecaudo = pagoOnline.FechaRecaudo as DateTime
var diferenciaDias = daysBetween( fechaRecaudo as Date, (now() >> "America/Bogota") as Date )
--- (entidadRecaudadora != (pagoOnline.EntidadRecaudadora default "")) and (cuentaRecaudadora != (pagoOnline.CuentaRecaudadora default "")) and (diferenciaDias > 1)
